title: gates: nextest runs each test without its double spawn
goal: On a cloud VM's 4 cores Susi's customer suite spent about 1.5 of its 21 s of processor time on nextest starting itself again before each test (__double-spawn, 352 starts of its 32 MB binary); with NEXTEST_DOUBLE_SPAWN=0 Susi's phase 1 took 8.1-8.4 s, not 9.4-10.0. The double spawn guards job control (Ctrl-Z) in a terminal; the gates run no terminal. Set it for nextest steps unless the caller names it.
